DitherHalftone.source: What sizes the dots: noise (drifting clouds), radial (largest at center) or linear (growing towards direction).
DitherHalftone.center: Radial only: where the dots are largest, and where they run out. 1 reaches the farthest corner.
DitherHalftone.radius: Radial only: where the dots are largest, and where they run out. 1 reaches the farthest corner.
DitherHalftone.direction: Linear only: the direction the dots grow towards, in degrees as in CSS.
DitherHalftone.scale: Noise only: size of the clouds.
DitherHalftone.angle: Screen angle in degrees. Extra channels add 30° each.
DitherHalftone.intensity: Size of the largest dot, 0 to 1. At 1 the biggest dots just touch.
DitherHalftone.drift: How fast the screen slides. 0 holds it still.
DitherHalftone.channels: Two or three inks, each on its own screen. Where dots overlap their colours mix. Replaces color.
DitherHalftone.cell: Size of one rendered pixel. One device pixel keeps dot edges crisp.
